wave.description: Upcoming or active 1-based wave; 0 in preparation; retained during pause/defeat

waves_cleared.description: Completed waves including the rest wave

wave_total.description: Scheduled enemies in the current combat wave; 0 in preparation/countdown/rest; retain on pause/defeat

wave_spawned.description: Emitted enemies in the current combat wave; 0 in preparation/countdown/rest; retain on pause/defeat

enemies_alive.description: Living emitted enemies; freeze after terminal damage/death resolution on defeat

enemies_remaining.description: wave_total - wave_spawned + enemies_alive; retain on pause, freeze after terminal resolution on defeat

countdown_seconds.description: Remaining countdown/rest time; 0 in preparation/combat; retained during pause/defeat

mine_price.description: Current displayed purchase price for mine

archer_price.description: Current displayed purchase price for archer

cannon_price.description: Current displayed purchase price for cannon

wall_price.description: Current displayed purchase price for wall

coordinates.board: 20 x 20; cell [column,row], zero-based 0..19, top-left origin; integer coordinates are cell centers
coordinates.position: [column_fraction,row_fraction,height_in_cell_units]; integer ground coordinates are cell centers; off-board entry coordinates may be negative or above 19
coordinates.rect: [left,top,width,height] normalized to the actual game client; top-left origin

authority: Only maps GDD Section 6; creates no additional gameplay.
